shellCommands.command: git diff && ls -la && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -100

cd /workspace; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json .gitignore app/*; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; echo; head -50 __agent_eval__/run.mjs; ls node_modules/next/package.json && grep '"version"' node_modules/next/package.json
cd /workspace/node_modules/next; ls; ls dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rl "partial prerender\|static shell" dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd /workspace/node_modules/next; cat AGENTS.md; ls dist/docs/01-app/*; grep -rl "static shell" dist/docs/01-app/0[12]* | head -20
cd /workspace && git rm -q app/loading.tsx && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

f=$(ls .next/server/app/index.html 2>/dev/null || find .next -name 'index.html' | head -1); echo $f; grep -o '<main>.*</main>' "$f" | head -c 2000; echo; git checkout -q tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null; git status --short
